svg.title: Abram’s road: Ur to the Negev (Genesis 11:31–12:9)
svg.desc: Two maps. Above: the Fertile Crescent, from Ur in southern Mesopotamia up the Euphrates to Haran, then south through Aleppo and Damascus to Shechem and on toward the Negev. Below: the land of Canaan from Shechem through Bethel and Ai to the Negev. Stars mark where God speaks: at Haran, “Go… to the land that I will show you” (12:1), and at Shechem, “The LORD appeared” (12:7). Altars stand at Shechem and between Bethel and Ai, with a tent. Green marks land watered by rain or river (today’s climate: Köppen-Geiger, Beck et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0).
